Two candidates of ONE rank (two `main`s) stay K_ProgramEntryAmbiguous. This replaces `entry_main_and_wmain_ambiguous_pe`, which pinned the refusal the references do not make. `positioned: false` because the choice is a WHOLE-PROGRAM fact with no single declaration at fault. * THE EXIT CODE IS THE WITNESS: main returns 4, wmain returns 7. * RED-ON-DISABLE: remove `entryPrecedence` from the pe64 exec document and the build is refused K_ProgramEntryAmbiguous; remove `argc-wargv` from its `entryVerbs` and the warning stops (only `main` survives), so `expectWarnings` reddens.
